message: The other day, as the storm clouds rolled in, our family group chat lit up like a Christmas tree. My daughter sent a meme about how we’d all be fine as long as the Wi-Fi held up, while my son shared a list of snacks he was ‘stockpiling’ (mostly chips and soda). Between the jokes and the eye-rolls, I reminded everyone to check their flashlights and water supplies. It’s funny how a bit of humor can make prepping feel less like a chore and more like a bonding experience. How do you keep spirits up during storm prep?
